title: "The per-language file beside a language file in a subfolder is found"
format: subdirfile-html
toc: true
lang: fr
_quarto:
  tests:
    subdirfile-html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<h2 id="toc-title">Sommaire du sous-dossier</h2>']
        - ['Contents from the extension subfolder']

## Section

The `subdirfile` extension keeps its language files in the `i18n/` subfolder.
Quarto must find `i18n/strings.yml`, and then load `i18n/strings-fr.yml` next to it for `lang: fr`.
The table of contents must show the French title, not the English title.
